visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light grey hoodie and a navy blue baseball cap with a white logo, sits in an airplane seat. She holds a smartphone displaying the YouTube interface and looks towards the camera with a wide-eyed, surprised expression. The lighting is bright and even within the cabin, showing the seat's dark green headrest behind her. (2) The woman shifts focus to the phone screen, showing a webpage for 'EVA Wi-Fi' with several plan options listed in Traditional Chinese. She gestures towards the screen and then transitions to a playful pout, resting her chin on her hand while looking directly at the camera. (3) The scene cuts to a clear screen recording of the mobile interface. The user scrolls through three pricing tiers: 100MB for $14.95, 300MB for $29.95, and 'Streaming Experience' for $39.95. The text is crisp against a white background with green accents. (4) Further screen recording shows the payment checkout page. Icons for MasterCard, Visa, American Express, and PayPal are visible. Then, buttons for 'PayPal', 'Alipay', and 'Apple Pay' are displayed. A green progress bar or checkmark appears, followed by a countdown timer showing nearly 24 hours of remaining time. (5) The camera returns to the woman in her seat. She smiles broadly and gives a confident thumbs-up to the camera while holding her phone, which now displays a connection confirmation. The background shows the airplane cabin curtains and luggage bins. (6) The final phase shows a close-up of the phone screen as the woman scrolls through various YouTube video thumbnails. The movement is fluid and fast, demonstrating the connection's responsiveness. Her fingers tap on a video of a man talking, and the video starts playing immediately without buffering.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a review and how-to guide for purchasing paid high-speed Wi-Fi on an EVA Air flight. It captures the creator's surprise at the speed of the service and provides a step-by-step walkthrough of the UI and payment process to encourage others to buy it for long-haul productivity.
